row:
The only AAHA accredited animal hospital in Mount Vernon, Ohio. We provide high quality care to our small animal patients. Our channel will provide an insight to our daily activities, clarification to recommendations, and guidance to our pet parents. We welcome feedback and suggestions on how we can help our patients live their lives to the fullest.

completecare.tv
completecareanimalhospital.com
completecareanimalhospital@gmail.com

740-397-7146
